description: Augmentation strength under Muon. Base: E100 code. In the 28 and 32 px phases only, raise the translate magnitude from 2 to 4 px (same reflect padding and the same fused GPU op; the pad width is a host-side constant per phase). If the augment op is compiled, warm both pad variants in build. The 16/24 px phases, flip, LS and everything else stay unchanged. Smoke-test that one batch of translated images is in range and shape-correct. Decide untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled 200-trajectory E100 baseline. Add one scored sample, and a second only if the gain is >= +0.05 pp.
